test_objective: Check that you can retrieve a Context Source Registration

test_cases.name: 036_04_01 Retrieve Context Source Registration
test_cases.doc: Check that you can retrieve a Context Source Registration
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response containing:
        Response containing:
    * file set to 'csourceRegistrations/expectations/context-source-registration.json'
    * id set to '${context_source_registration_id}'
    * response set to '${response.json()}' and
        Response Status Code set to 200
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations/{context_source_registration_id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve Context Source Registration with data: and
    Query Parameter: context source registration id set to '${context_source_registration_id}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
